title: Coast Guard rescues 4 boaters during sailboat regatta near Dauphin Island, Alabama
description: Coast Guard Station Dauphin Island crew rescues boater June 28, 2024, near Dauphin Island, Alabama. Reportedly after the catamaran vessel capsized, all four persons aboard took refuge on the overturned boat and activated personal locator beacons (PLBs). (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Station Dauphin Island)
